answer: At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a signal tag. The meadow cap is enforced at intake and ember publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
